_comment: Vanilla Meta SAM (vit_h) for class-shape detection. Bbox-only output: each surviving mask is assigned to the first class whose shape rule it matches. Built-in classes: 'road' (long, skinny) and 'building' (compact). Override via kwargs.class_rules. Weights auto-download from Meta's CDN (~2.4GB for vit_h) to ./tmp/weights on first run.

kwargs._comment_speed: vit_b is ~10x faster than vit_h on CPU and noticeably less accurate, but at the resolutions we feed SAM the difference is small. Switch to vit_h if quality matters more than runtime.
